item.title: Nissen Richards Studio completes Hartdene Barns by Nissen Richards Studio
item.description: Hartdene Barns is a stunning, newly-completed collection of nine luxury, carbon-net-zero eco homes, set within forty acres of land within an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty (AONB) in the UK’s green belt, close to the villages of Hartfield and Cowden on the border of West Kent and East Sussex. The development was designed by architects Nissen Richards Studio for Q New Homes. item.title: New Sarezzo Primary School by ATI Project
item.description: School becomes a formal landscape capable of educating in a sustainable way The new ‘Mariele Ventre’ Primary School in Sarezzo represents an innovative model of educational architecture, a space that engages with its surroundings, shaping light, volumes, and materials to make the learning experience more stimulating and sustainable. item.title: 83 Freight by Smith Gee Studio
item.description: Located in Nashville’s Wedgewood Houston neighborhood, 83 Freight provides unique, sustainable living options through an architecture of reflection, inspiration, and a sense of place representative of this location. As the largest residential shipping container community in North America, one hundred seventy-three shipping containers are stacked, rotated, and offset from three buildings of 83 residential units of varying sizes. item.title: Ravine House by Orangeink Design
item.description: Commissioned as a ‘forever’ home for a local couple, the program involved modernizing a 1960s-era bungalow. The vision: to use the home’s good bones as a starting point and transform a low-slung, inward-looking, dark space into a welcoming, light-filled modern home, comfortable and intimate for the family, yet flexible and inviting for entertaining. item.title: MVRDV completes earth-covered timber pavilion near Chengdu
item.description: MVRDV has completed the Pujiang Platform, a timber pavilion and viewpoint located in the hills east of Pujiang , a new town under development southwest of Chengdu, China. The project upgrades an existing lookout point into a visitor destination and multipurpose event venue.
